main_topics.reason: User came to understand what POTS means after a rushed appointment and kept asking why it happened and whether it was permanent.
User said the fear of a damaged heart was what scared them and later reported feeling much less panicked.
User asked what they can do and wrote down salt, fluids, compression, counter-maneuvers and in-the-moment steps over several turns.
User was confused and scared about exercise because pushing themselves causes multi-day crashes, and felt validated by the answer.
User described pounding heart, dizziness and spotty vision on standing and asked how to stop it faster in the moment.
User asked in one exchange whether POTS is permanent.
User asked once why long COVID caused this given prior good health.
User asked one question about whether they should be on medication since none was prescribed.
User mentioned the doctor explained quickly and that the chat was more useful than the appointment.
User noted a question to write down for the doctor about medication options.

output.summary: A user newly told they have POTS alongside long COVID asked what it means, whether their heart is damaged, why it happened, whether it is permanent and what they can do. The bot explained clearly, covered self-management including pacing given post-exertional crashes, and gave in-the-moment tips. The user said they felt much less panicked and understood the condition, and no safety-critical moments arose.
